title: Nonlinear quantum Fokker-Planck equation near equilibrium
summary: We investigate a nonlinear quantum Fokker--Planck equation with self-consistent collision frequency, bulk velocity, and temperature. In contrast to quantum Fokker--Planck equations with prescribed diffusion and friction coefficients, the macroscopic quantities are nonlinear functionals of the distribution function. The equation preserves mass, momentum, and kinetic energy, admits a quantum entropy dissipation structure, and propagates the Pauli admissible range in the fermionic case.
